import sys,json,tarfile,hashlib;from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);old=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);new=json.loads(sys.argv[3]);p=r/'stage/tools-r2.tar';assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[4]
assert not any((r/'run'/n).exists() for n in ['fdb','mgmtd','meta','storage','fuse'])
for k,v in old.items():assert hashlib.sha256((r/'tools'/k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v
with tarfile.open(p) as a:
 m=a.getmembers();assert len(m)==2 and all(x.isfile() and x.name in new for x in m)
 for x in m:
  data=a.extractfile(x).read();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==new[x.name];(r/'tools'/x.name).write_bytes(data)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_TOOLS_R2_NO_SERVICE','new_sha256':new}))
